newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Sunday it had invited bids up to Tuesday for the auction of the six-month federal bonds.
The auction results will be announced on Wednesday with settlement set for Thursday, the bank said.
It said a pre-auction target had been set at 12 billion rupees, but bids could be rejected without giving any reason.
In the previous auction on October 22, bids worth 5.165 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 14.27106 percent per annum, against a pre-auction target of 13.065 billion rupees.
